festivals: Chicabal: CONAP describes an annual Rogativa por la Lluvia ceremony forty days after Semana Santa. Confirm timing and any visitor access with ASAECO; no Gregorian date or public-access entitlement inferred.
closures: Volcán Chicabal: Monday-Sunday 09:00-16:00. The page recommends, rather than expressly mandates, a guide with a current tourism credential.

No fee, unrestricted-access or guide-compulsion inference from generic recommendations. The official guide describes the recurring ceremony as forty days after Holy Week; it does not specify the anchor day, so no Gregorian date is calculated and no attendance permission is inferred.

culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: ASAECO (Asociación de Agricultores Ecológicos de La Laguna de Chicabal), identified by CONAP as the Maya Mam family association managing the activities.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Chicabal is identified as a sacred place with ceremonies at the lagoon. The government visitor description is not consent to attend, photograph or record ceremonies; community-specific permission procedures not yet checked.
